decisions.reason: Identifies the running dsh web host PID 42432 as holding the loaded koffi.node native binary, causing npm copyfile EBUSY until the host exits.
Explains browser refresh does not stop the native-module-owning host and gives the ordered stop, confirm exit, install, verify, restart sequence without killing unrelated Node processes.
Explains bare npm install follows latest at 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, so it can downgrade the installed alpha rather than preserving it.
Provides npm install -g with exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus the TUI plugin, followed by version verification and host restart.
Tells README authors to pin the tested core version in combined plugin install commands and avoid silently following latest over prerelease installs.
